int compare_text(string first, string second)
    int[] left_codes := first.codepoints()
    int[] right_codes := second.codepoints()
    count := if #left_codes < #right_codes then #left_codes else #right_codes
    for: i < count
        if left_codes[i] != right_codes[i]
            return if left_codes[i] < right_codes[i] then -1 else 1
    return if #left_codes < #right_codes then -1 elif #left_codes > #right_codes then 1 else 0

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool includes<T>(T[] values, T target)
    for value := values[]
        if value == target
            return true
    return false

int absolute(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int quotient(int numerator, int denominator)
    magnitude := absolute(numerator) / absolute(denominator)
    return if (numerator < 0) != (denominator < 0) then -magnitude else magnitude

string uppercase(string text)
    result := ""
    lower := "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    upper := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
    for: i < #text
        character := text[i]
        for: j < #lower
            if character == lower[j]
                character = upper[j]
                break
        result += character
    return result

class Value(kind := 0, number := 0, text := "")
    string written()
        return if kind == 0 then "NULL" elif kind == 1 then string(number) else text

    int truth()
        return if kind == 0 then -1 elif number == 0 then 0 else 1

int compare(Value left, Value right)
    if left.kind == 0 or right.kind == 0
        return if left.kind == right.kind then 0 elif left.kind == 0 then -1 else 1
    if left.kind == 1
        return if left.number < right.number then -1 elif left.number > right.number then 1 else 0
    return compare_text(left.text, right.text)

Value boolean(int truth)
    return if truth < 0 then Value() else Value(1, truth)

Value negate(Value value)
    return boolean(if value.truth() < 0 then -1 elif value.truth() == 0 then 1 else 0)

Value conjunction(Value left, Value right, disjunction := false)
    a := left.truth()
    b := right.truth()
    if disjunction
        return boolean(if a == 1 or b == 1 then 1 elif a < 0 or b < 0 then -1 else 0)
    return boolean(if a == 0 or b == 0 then 0 elif a < 0 or b < 0 then -1 else 1)

bool like(string text, string pattern)
    previous := array(#text + 1, fill = false)
    previous[0] = true
    for: i < #pattern
        current := array(#text + 1, fill = false)
        if pattern[i] == "%"
            current[0] = previous[0]
        for: 1 <= j <= #text
            current[j] = if pattern[i] == "%" then previous[j] or current[j - 1] else previous[j - 1] and (pattern[i] == "_" or pattern[i] == text[j - 1])
        previous = current
    return previous[#text]

Value binary(string operation, Value left, Value right)
    if operation == "AND" or operation == "OR"
        return conjunction(left, right, operation == "OR")
    if left.kind == 0 or right.kind == 0
        return Value()
    if operation == "+"
        return Value(1, left.number + right.number)
    if operation == "-"
        return Value(1, left.number - right.number)
    if operation == "*"
        return Value(1, left.number * right.number)
    if operation == "/" or operation == "%"
        if right.number == 0
            return Value()
        divided := quotient(left.number, right.number)
        return Value(1, if operation == "/" then divided else left.number - right.number * divided)
    if operation == "||"
        return Value(2, text = left.text + right.text)
    if operation == "LIKE"
        return Value(1, if like(left.text, right.text) then 1 else 0)
    relation := compare(left, right)
    result := if operation == "=" then relation == 0 elif operation == "<>" or operation == "!=" then relation != 0 elif operation == "<" then relation < 0 elif operation == "<=" then relation <= 0 elif operation == ">" then relation > 0 else relation >= 0
    return Value(1, if result then 1 else 0)

class Token(string kind, string value, string written)

Token[] | error tokenize(string text)
    reserved := "SELECT DISTINCT FROM AS JOIN INNER LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC LIMIT OFFSET INSERT INTO VALUES UPDATE SET DELETE CREATE TABLE DROP PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL INT TEXT AND OR IS IN BETWEEN LIKE COUNT SUM MIN MAX AVG EXIT".split(" ")
    letters := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_"
    digits := "0123456789"
    Token[] tokens := []
    nat position := 0
    while position < #text
        character := text[position]
        if character == " " or character == NL
            position += 1
            continue
        if position + 1 < #text and text[position:<position + 2] == "--"
            while position < #text and text[position] != NL
                position += 1
            continue
        begin := position
        if character == "'"
            position += 1
            while position < #text and text[position] != "'"
                position += 1
            position += 1
            tokens = tokens.append(Token("string", text[begin + 1:<position - 1], text[begin:<position]))
        elif digits.contains(character)
            while position < #text and digits.contains(text[position])
                position += 1
            written := text[begin:<position]
            tokens = tokens.append(Token("integer", written, written))
        elif letters.contains(character)
            while position < #text and (letters + digits).contains(text[position])
                position += 1
            written := text[begin:<position]
            upper := uppercase(written)
            tokens = tokens.append(Token(if includes(reserved, upper) then "reserved" else "name", if includes(reserved, upper) then upper else written, written))
        elif position + 1 < #text and includes(["<>", "!=", "<=", ">=", "||"], text[position:<position + 2])
            written := text[position:<position + 2]
            tokens = tokens.append(Token("symbol", written, written))
            position += 2
        elif "(),.;*/%+-=<>".contains(character)
            tokens = tokens.append(Token("symbol", character, character))
            position += 1
        else
            return error("unexpected character '" + character + "'")
    return tokens

class Expression(string operation, int[] children := [], literal := Value(), table_name := "", column_name := "", written := "", is_distinct := false, resolved := -1)
class Column(string name, int type_id, not_null := false, primary_count := 0)
class Table(string name, Column[] columns, Value[][] rows := [])
class TableRef(string name, string alias)
class Join(TableRef table_ref, bool outer, int condition)
class SelectItem(int expression, string alias, string heading)
class OrderItem(int expression, bool descending, string single_kind, string single_value)
class Statement()
    command := ""
    table_name := ""
    Column[] columns := []
    string[] targets := []
    int[][] tuples := []
    int[] assignments := []
    where_id := -1
    is_distinct := false
    star := false
    SelectItem[] items := []
    source := TableRef("", "")
    Join[] joins := []
    int[] groups := []
    grouped := false
    having := -1
    OrderItem[] ordering := []
    limit := -1
    offset := 0

class Parser(Token[] tokens)
    nat position := 0
    Expression[] nodes := []

    Token peek()
        return tokens[position]

    error failure()
        return error("syntax error at '" + peek().written + "'")

    bool at(string text)
        Token token := peek()
        return (token.kind == "symbol" or token.kind == "reserved") and token.value == text

    bool .accept(string text)
        if not at(text)
            return false
        position += 1
        return true

    void | error .expect(string text)
        if not .accept(text)
            return failure()
        return void

    string | error .name()
        if peek().kind != "name"
            return failure()
        string result := peek().value
        position += 1
        return result

    int .add(Expression node_input)
        result := int(#nodes)
        nodes = nodes.append(node_input)
        return result

    int | error .column_ref()
        string first := try .name()
        if .accept(".")
            string second := try .name()
            return .add(Expression("column", table_name = first, column_name = second, written = first + "." + second))
        return .add(Expression("column", column_name = first, written = first))

    int | error .primary()
        Token token := peek()
        if token.kind == "integer" or token.kind == "string" or at("NULL")
            position += 1
            value := if token.kind == "integer" then Value(1, int(token.value)) elif token.kind == "string" then Value(2, text = token.value) else Value()
            return .add(Expression("literal", literal = value))
        if token.kind == "name"
            return try .column_ref()
        if .accept("(")
            int inner := try .expression()
            try .expect(")")
            return .add(Expression("group", [inner]))
        if includes(["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX", "AVG"], token.value) and token.kind == "reserved"
            position += 1
            try .expect("(")
            is_distinct := false
            int[] children := []
            if token.value == "COUNT" and .accept("*")
                void
            else
                is_distinct = .accept("DISTINCT")
                int argument := try .expression()
                children = [argument]
            try .expect(")")
            return .add(Expression("aggregate", children, written = token.value, is_distinct = is_distinct))
        return failure()

    int | error .unary()
        if .accept("-")
            int operand := try .unary()
            return .add(Expression("negative", [operand]))
        return try .primary()

    int | error .multiplicative()
        int left := try .unary()
        while at("*") or at("/") or at("%")
            string operation := peek().value
            position += 1
            int right := try .unary()
            left = .add(Expression(operation, [left, right]))
        return left

    int | error .additive()
        int left := try .multiplicative()
        while at("+") or at("-") or at("||")
            string operation := peek().value
            position += 1
            int right := try .multiplicative()
            left = .add(Expression(operation, [left, right]))
        return left

    int | error .comparison()
        int left := try .additive()
        if includes(["=", "<>", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="], peek().value) and peek().kind == "symbol"
            string operation := peek().value
            position += 1
            int right := try .additive()
            return .add(Expression(operation, [left, right]))
        if .accept("IS")
            bool negated := .accept("NOT")
            try .expect("NULL")
            return .add(Expression(if negated then "IS NOT NULL" else "IS NULL", [left]))
        bool negated := .accept("NOT")
        operation := ""
        children := [left]
        if .accept("IN")
            operation = "IN"
            try .expect("(")
            while true
                int item := try .expression()
                children = children.append(item)
                if not .accept(",")
                    break
            try .expect(")")
        elif .accept("BETWEEN")
            operation = "BETWEEN"
            int low := try .additive()
            try .expect("AND")
            int high := try .additive()
            children = children.append(low).append(high)
        elif .accept("LIKE")
            operation = "LIKE"
            int pattern := try .additive()
            children = children.append(pattern)
        elif negated
            return failure()
        else
            return left
        int result := .add(Expression(operation, children))
        return if negated then .add(Expression("NOT", [result])) else result

    int | error .not_expression()
        if .accept("NOT")
            int operand := try .not_expression()
            return .add(Expression("NOT", [operand]))
        return try .comparison()

    int | error .and_expression()
        int left := try .not_expression()
        while .accept("AND")
            int right := try .not_expression()
            left = .add(Expression("AND", [left, right]))
        return left

    int | error .expression()
        int left := try .and_expression()
        while .accept("OR")
            int right := try .and_expression()
            left = .add(Expression("OR", [left, right]))
        return left

    string | error .alias()
        if .accept("AS")
            return try .name()
        if peek().kind == "name"
            return try .name()
        return ""

    TableRef | error .table_ref()
        string table_name := try .name()
        string table_alias := try .alias()
        return TableRef(table_name, if table_alias == "" then table_name else table_alias)

    string heading(nat begin, nat end, int expression_id)
        node := nodes[expression_id]
        if node.operation == "column"
            return node.column_name
        result := ""
        for: begin <= i < end
            if i > begin and tokens[i - 1].kind != "symbol" and tokens[i].kind != "symbol"
                result += " "
            result += tokens[i].written
        return result

    Statement | error .parse()
        statement := Statement()
        if at(";")
            position += 1
            return statement
        if .accept("CREATE")
            statement.command = "CREATE"
            try .expect("TABLE")
            statement.table_name = try .name()
            try .expect("(")
            while true
                string column_name := try .name()
                type_id := 0
                if .accept("INT")
                    type_id = 1
                elif .accept("TEXT")
                    type_id = 2
                else
                    return failure()
                primary_count := 0
                not_null := false
                while at("PRIMARY") or at("NOT")
                    if .accept("PRIMARY")
                        try .expect("KEY")
                        primary_count += 1
                        not_null = true
                    else
                        try .expect("NOT")
                        try .expect("NULL")
                        not_null = true
                statement.columns = statement.columns.append(Column(column_name, type_id, not_null, primary_count))
                if not .accept(",")
                    break
            try .expect(")")
        elif .accept("DROP")
            statement.command = "DROP"
            try .expect("TABLE")
            statement.table_name = try .name()
        elif .accept("INSERT")
            statement.command = "INSERT"
            try .expect("INTO")
            statement.table_name = try .name()
            if .accept("(")
                while true
                    string target := try .name()
                    statement.targets = statement.targets.append(target)
                    if not .accept(",")
                        break
                try .expect(")")
            try .expect("VALUES")
            while true
                try .expect("(")
                int[] tuple := []
                while true
                    int item := try .expression()
                    tuple = tuple.append(item)
                    if not .accept(",")
                        break
                try .expect(")")
                statement.tuples = statement.tuples.append(tuple)
                if not .accept(",")
                    break
        elif .accept("UPDATE")
            statement.command = "UPDATE"
            statement.table_name = try .name()
            try .expect("SET")
            while true
                string target := try .name()
                try .expect("=")
                int item := try .expression()
                statement.targets = statement.targets.append(target)
                statement.assignments = statement.assignments.append(item)
                if not .accept(",")
                    break
            if .accept("WHERE")
                statement.where_id = try .expression()
        elif .accept("DELETE")
            statement.command = "DELETE"
            try .expect("FROM")
            statement.table_name = try .name()
            if .accept("WHERE")
                statement.where_id = try .expression()
        elif .accept("SELECT")
            statement.command = "SELECT"
            statement.is_distinct = .accept("DISTINCT")
            statement.star = .accept("*")
            if not statement.star
                while true
                    begin := position
                    int item := try .expression()
                    string title := heading(begin, position, item)
                    string item_alias := try .alias()
                    statement.items = statement.items.append(SelectItem(item, item_alias, if item_alias == "" then title else item_alias))
                    if not .accept(",")
                        break
            try .expect("FROM")
            statement.source = try .table_ref()
            while at("JOIN") or at("INNER") or at("LEFT")
                bool outer := .accept("LEFT")
                if outer
                    bool optional_outer := .accept("OUTER")
                else
                    bool optional_inner := .accept("INNER")
                try .expect("JOIN")
                TableRef joined := try .table_ref()
                try .expect("ON")
                int condition := try .expression()
                statement.joins = statement.joins.append(Join(joined, outer, condition))
            if .accept("WHERE")
                statement.where_id = try .expression()
            if .accept("GROUP")
                statement.grouped = true
                try .expect("BY")
                while true
                    int item := try .column_ref()
                    statement.groups = statement.groups.append(item)
                    if not .accept(",")
                        break
            if .accept("HAVING")
                statement.having = try .expression()
            if .accept("ORDER")
                try .expect("BY")
                while true
                    begin := position
                    int item := try .expression()
                    single_kind := if position == begin + 1 then tokens[begin].kind else ""
                    single_value := if single_kind == "" then "" else tokens[begin].value
                    bool descending := .accept("DESC")
                    if not descending
                        bool ascending := .accept("ASC")
                    statement.ordering = statement.ordering.append(OrderItem(item, descending, single_kind, single_value))
                    if not .accept(",")
                        break
            if .accept("LIMIT")
                if peek().kind != "integer"
                    return failure()
                statement.limit = int(peek().value)
                position += 1
                if .accept("OFFSET")
                    if peek().kind != "integer"
                        return failure()
                    statement.offset = int(peek().value)
                    position += 1
        elif .accept("EXIT")
            statement.command = "EXIT"
        else
            return failure()
        try .expect(";")
        return statement

class ScopeColumn(string table_name, Column column)

bool compatible(int first, int second)
    return first == 0 or second == 0 or first == second

class Evaluator(Expression[] nodes)
    int | error .resolve(int expression_id, ScopeColumn[] scope)
        node := nodes[expression_id]
        table_found := node.table_name == ""
        found := -1
        for: i < #scope
            entry := scope[i]
            if node.table_name != "" and entry.table_name != node.table_name
                continue
            table_found = true
            if entry.column.name == node.column_name
                if found >= 0
                    return error("ambiguous column " + node.column_name)
                found = int(i)
        if not table_found
            return error("unknown table " + node.table_name)
        if found < 0
            return error("unknown column " + node.written)
        nodes[expression_id].resolved = found
        return found

    int | error .check(int expression_id, ScopeColumn[] scope, bool aggregates, bool grouping, int[] group_columns, inside := false)
        node := nodes[expression_id]
        operation := node.operation
        if operation == "literal"
            return node.literal.kind
        if operation == "column"
            int column_id := try .resolve(expression_id, scope)
            if grouping and not inside and not includes(group_columns, column_id)
                return error("column " + node.written + " is not grouped")
            return scope[column_id].column.type_id
        if operation == "aggregate"
            if not aggregates or inside
                return error("misuse of aggregate " + node.written)
            if #node.children == 0
                return 1
            int argument_type := try .check(node.children[0], scope, aggregates, grouping, group_columns, true)
            if (node.written == "SUM" or node.written == "AVG") and not compatible(argument_type, 1)
                return error("type mismatch for " + node.written)
            return if node.written == "MIN" or node.written == "MAX" then argument_type else 1
        int[] types := []
        for child := node.children[]
            int type_id := try .check(child, scope, aggregates, grouping, group_columns, inside)
            types = types.append(type_id)
        if operation == "group"
            return types[0]
        if operation == "IS NULL" or operation == "IS NOT NULL"
            return 1
        display := if operation == "negative" then "-" else operation
        if includes(["IN", "BETWEEN", "=", "!=", "<>", "<", "<=", ">", ">="], operation)
            for: 1 <= i < #types
                if not compatible(types[0], types[i])
                    return error("type mismatch for " + display)
        else
            wanted := if operation == "LIKE" or operation == "||" then 2 else 1
            for type_id := types[]
                if not compatible(type_id, wanted)
                    return error("type mismatch for " + display)
        return if operation == "||" then 2 else 1

    void | error .condition(int expression_id, string clause, ScopeColumn[] scope, bool aggregates, bool grouping, int[] group_columns)
        if expression_id < 0
            return
        int type_id := try .check(expression_id, scope, aggregates, grouping, group_columns)
        if not compatible(type_id, 1)
            return error("type mismatch for " + clause)
        return void

    bool has_aggregate(int expression_id)
        node := nodes[expression_id]
        if node.operation == "aggregate"
            return true
        for child := node.children[]
            if has_aggregate(child)
                return true
        return false

    Value evaluate(int expression_id, Value[] row, Value[][] group)
        node := nodes[expression_id]
        operation := node.operation
        if operation == "literal"
            return node.literal
        if operation == "column"
            return row[node.resolved]
        if operation == "aggregate"
            if #node.children == 0
                return Value(1, int(#group))
            Value[] values := []
            for member := group[]
                Value value := evaluate(node.children[0], member, [])
                if value.kind != 0 and (not node.is_distinct or not includes(values, value))
                    values = values.append(value)
            if node.written == "COUNT"
                return Value(1, int(#values))
            if #values == 0
                return Value()
            result := values[0]
            if node.written == "MIN" or node.written == "MAX"
                for value := values[]
                    relation := compare(value, result)
                    if (node.written == "MIN" and relation < 0) or (node.written == "MAX" and relation > 0)
                        result = value
                return result
            sum := 0
            for value := values[]
                sum += value.number
            return Value(1, if node.written == "AVG" then quotient(sum, int(#values)) else sum)
        Value[] values := [for child := node.children[] then evaluate(child, row, group)]
        left := values[0]
        if operation == "group"
            return left
        if operation == "negative"
            return if left.kind == 0 then left else Value(1, -left.number)
        if operation == "NOT"
            return negate(left)
        if operation == "IS NULL" or operation == "IS NOT NULL"
            result := (left.kind == 0) == (operation == "IS NULL")
            return Value(1, if result then 1 else 0)
        if operation == "IN"
            result := Value(1, 0)
            for: 1 <= i < #values
                result = conjunction(result, binary("=", left, values[i]), true)
            return result
        if operation == "BETWEEN"
            return conjunction(binary(">=", left, values[1]), binary("<=", left, values[2]))
        return binary(operation, left, values[1])

    bool matches(int expression_id, Value[] row, Value[][] group)
        return expression_id < 0 or evaluate(expression_id, row, group).truth() == 1

class ResultRow(Value[] output, Value[] keys)

bool before(ResultRow left, ResultRow right, OrderItem[] ordering)
    for: i < #ordering
        relation := compare(left.keys[i], right.keys[i])
        if relation != 0
            return if ordering[i].descending then relation > 0 else relation < 0
    return false

string[] render(string[] headings, int[] types, ResultRow[] rows)
    widths := [for heading := headings[] then #heading]
    for row := rows[]
        for: i < #widths
            size := #row.output[i].written()
            if size > widths[i]
                widths[i] = size
    rule := "+"
    header := "|"
    for: i < #widths
        rule += "-" * (widths[i] + 2) + "+"
        header += " " + headings[i] + " " * (widths[i] - #headings[i]) + " |"
    output := [rule, header, rule]
    for row := rows[]
        line := "|"
        for: i < #widths
            text := row.output[i].written()
            string padding := " " * (widths[i] - #text)
            line += " " + (if types[i] == 1 then padding + text else text + padding) + " |"
        output = output.append(line)
    return output.append(rule).append("({#rows} " + (if #rows == 1 then "row)" else "rows)"))

class Database()
    Table[] tables := []

    int table_index(string name)
        for: i < #tables
            if tables[i].name == name
                return int(i)
        return -1

    int | error require_table(string name)
        int found := table_index(name)
        if found < 0
            return error("unknown table " + name)
        return found

    int[] | error target_columns(Table table, string[] targets)
        int[] result := []
        for target := targets[]
            found := -1
            for: i < #table.columns
                if table.columns[i].name == target
                    found = int(i)
            if found < 0
                return error("unknown column " + target)
            if includes(result, found)
                return error("duplicate column " + target)
            result = result.append(found)
        return result

    void | error constraints(Table table, int[] checked_rows)
        primary := -1
        for: i < #table.columns
            if table.columns[i].primary_count > 0
                primary = int(i)
        for row_id := checked_rows[]
            row := table.rows[row_id]
            for: i < #table.columns
                if table.columns[i].not_null and row[i].kind == 0
                    return error("NULL value in column " + table.columns[i].name)
            if primary >= 0
                for: other < #table.rows
                    if int(other) != row_id and compare(table.rows[other][primary], row[primary]) == 0
                        return error("duplicate primary key " + row[primary].written())
        return void

    string[] | error select(Statement statement, Evaluator evaluator)
        TableRef[] references := [statement.source].concat([for joined := statement.joins[] then joined.table_ref])
        ScopeColumn[] scope := []
        string[] scope_names := []
        int[] table_ids := []
        for: i < #references
            reference := references[i]
            int table_id := try require_table(reference.name)
            if includes(scope_names, reference.alias)
                return error("duplicate table name " + reference.alias)
            scope_names = scope_names.append(reference.alias)
            table_ids = table_ids.append(table_id)
            for column := tables[table_id].columns[]
                scope = scope.append(ScopeColumn(reference.alias, column))
            if i > 0
                try .evaluator.condition(statement.joins[i - 1].condition, "ON", scope, false, false, [])
        try .evaluator.condition(statement.where_id, "WHERE", scope, false, false, [])
        int[] group_columns := []
        for expression_id := statement.groups[]
            column_id := try .evaluator.resolve(expression_id, scope)
            group_columns = group_columns.append(column_id)
        aggregate := statement.grouped or statement.having >= 0
        for item := statement.items[]
            aggregate = aggregate or evaluator.has_aggregate(item.expression)
        for item := statement.ordering[]
            aggregate = aggregate or evaluator.has_aggregate(item.expression)
        items := statement.items
        if statement.star
            for entry := scope[]
                expression_id := int(#evaluator.nodes)
                evaluator.nodes = evaluator.nodes.append(Expression("column", table_name = entry.table_name, column_name = entry.column.name, written = entry.column.name))
                items = items.append(SelectItem(expression_id, "", entry.column.name))
        int[] types := []
        for item := items[]
            type_id := try .evaluator.check(item.expression, scope, true, aggregate, group_columns)
            types = types.append(type_id)
        try .evaluator.condition(statement.having, "HAVING", scope, true, aggregate, group_columns)
        int[] order_select := []
        for item := statement.ordering[]
            selected := -1
            if item.single_kind == "integer"
                ordinal := int(item.single_value)
                if ordinal < 1 or ordinal > int(#items)
                    return error("ORDER BY position {ordinal} is out of range")
                selected = ordinal - 1
            elif item.single_kind == "name"
                for: i < #items
                    if items[i].alias == item.single_value
                        selected = int(i)
                        break
            if selected < 0
                checked_type := try .evaluator.check(item.expression, scope, true, aggregate, group_columns)
            order_select = order_select.append(selected)
        rows := tables[table_ids[0]].rows
        for: i < #statement.joins
            joined := statement.joins[i]
            right_table := tables[table_ids[i + 1]]
            Value[][] combined := []
            for left := rows[]
                found := false
                for right := right_table.rows[]
                    Value[] row := left.concat(right)
                    if evaluator.matches(joined.condition, row, [])
                        combined = combined.append(row)
                        found = true
                if joined.outer and not found
                    combined = combined.append(left.concat(array(#right_table.columns, fill = Value())))
            rows = combined
        rows = [for row := rows[] if evaluator.matches(statement.where_id, row, []) then row]
        Value[][][] groups := []
        if aggregate
            if not statement.grouped
                groups = [rows]
            else
                Value[][] keys := []
                for row := rows[]
                    key := [for column_id := group_columns[] then row[column_id]]
                    found := -1
                    for: i < #keys
                        if keys[i] == key
                            found = int(i)
                            break
                    if found < 0
                        keys = keys.append(key)
                        groups = groups.append([row])
                    else
                        groups[found] = groups[found].append(row)
        else
            groups = [for row := rows[] then [row]]
        ResultRow[] results := []
        for group := groups[]
            representative := if #group > 0 then group[0] else array(#scope, fill = Value())
            if not evaluator.matches(statement.having, representative, group)
                continue
            output := [for item := items[] then evaluator.evaluate(item.expression, representative, group)]
            Value[] keys := []
            for: i < #statement.ordering
                keys = keys.append(if order_select[i] >= 0 then output[order_select[i]] else evaluator.evaluate(statement.ordering[i].expression, representative, group))
            results = results.append(ResultRow(output, keys))
        for: 1 <= i < #results
            value := results[i]
            j := i
            while j > 0 and before(value, results[j - 1], statement.ordering)
                results[j] = results[j - 1]
                j -= 1
            results[j] = value
        if statement.is_distinct
            ResultRow[] unique := []
            Value[][] seen := []
            for result := results[]
                if not includes(seen, result.output)
                    unique = unique.append(result)
                    seen = seen.append(result.output)
            results = unique
        ResultRow[] selected_rows := []
        for: i < #results
            if int(i) >= statement.offset and (statement.limit < 0 or int(#selected_rows) < statement.limit)
                selected_rows = selected_rows.append(results[i])
        return render([for item := items[] then item.heading], types, selected_rows)

    string[] | error .execute(Statement statement, Expression[] nodes)
        command := statement.command
        evaluator := Evaluator(nodes)
        if command == "" or command == "EXIT"
            return []
        if command == "CREATE"
            if table_index(statement.table_name) >= 0
                return error("table " + statement.table_name + " already exists")
            string[] names := []
            primary_count := 0
            for column := statement.columns[]
                if includes(names, column.name)
                    return error("duplicate column " + column.name)
                names = names.append(column.name)
                primary_count += column.primary_count
                if primary_count >= 2
                    return error("multiple primary keys")
            tables = tables.append(Table(statement.table_name, statement.columns))
            return ["Table " + statement.table_name + " created."]
        if command == "SELECT"
            return try select(statement, evaluator)
        int table_id := try require_table(statement.table_name)
        if command == "DROP"
            tables = [for i := (nat(0):<#tables)[] if int(i) != table_id then tables[i]]
            return ["Table " + statement.table_name + " dropped."]
        modified := tables[table_id]
        scope := [for column := modified.columns[] then ScopeColumn(modified.name, column)]
        int[] targets := []
        if command == "INSERT" or command == "UPDATE"
            targets = try target_columns(modified, statement.targets)
            if command == "INSERT" and #statement.targets == 0
                targets = [for i := (nat(0):<#modified.columns)[] then int(i)]
        int[] changed := []
        if command == "INSERT"
            for tuple := statement.tuples[]
                if #tuple != #targets
                    return error("expected {#targets} values, got {#tuple}")
                for: i < #tuple
                    type_id := try .evaluator.check(tuple[i], [], false, false, [])
                    target := modified.columns[targets[i]]
                    if not compatible(type_id, target.type_id)
                        return error("type mismatch for column " + target.name)
            for tuple := statement.tuples[]
                row := array(#modified.columns, fill = Value())
                for: i < #tuple
                    row[targets[i]] = evaluator.evaluate(tuple[i], [], [])
                changed = changed.append(int(#modified.rows))
                modified.rows = modified.rows.append(row)
        else
            if command == "UPDATE"
                for: i < #statement.assignments
                    type_id := try .evaluator.check(statement.assignments[i], scope, false, false, [])
                    target := modified.columns[targets[i]]
                    if not compatible(type_id, target.type_id)
                        return error("type mismatch for column " + target.name)
            try .evaluator.condition(statement.where_id, "WHERE", scope, false, false, [])
            for: i < #modified.rows
                original := modified.rows[i]
                if evaluator.matches(statement.where_id, original, [])
                    changed = changed.append(int(i))
                    if command == "UPDATE"
                        for: j < #targets
                            modified.rows[i][targets[j]] = evaluator.evaluate(statement.assignments[j], original, [])
            if command == "DELETE"
                modified.rows = [for i := (nat(0):<#modified.rows)[] if not includes(changed, int(i)) then modified.rows[i]]
        if command != "DELETE"
            try constraints(modified, changed)
        tables[table_id] = modified
        action := if command == "INSERT" then "inserted" elif command == "UPDATE" then "updated" else "deleted"
        return ["{#changed} " + (if #changed == 1 then "row " else "rows ") + action + "."]

void process_statement(Database &database, string text)
    match tokenize(text)
        Token[] tokens
            parser := Parser(tokens)
            match .parser.parse()
                Statement statement
                    match .database.execute(statement, parser.nodes)
                        string[] output
                            for line := output[]
                                emit(line)
                        error problem
                            emit("ERROR: " + problem.message)
                error problem
                    emit("ERROR: " + problem.message)
        error problem
            emit("ERROR: " + problem.message)

void run_statements()
    database := Database()
    pending := ""
    while true
        line := ""
        scan(&line)
        if line == "EXIT;"
            break
        nat position := 0
        quoted := false
        while position < #line
            character := line[position]
            if not quoted and position + 1 < #line and line[position:<position + 2] == "--"
                break
            pending += character
            if character == "'"
                quoted = not quoted
            elif character == ";" and not quoted
                process_statement(&database, pending)
                pending = ""
            position += 1
        pending += NL

run_statements()
